description: One-step key request for a named agent, no admin and no proof required up front. Send agent (a 2-48 character label) and, optionally, contact (an email or https URL; accepted so you can forward the link, never stored). Returns a private claimable key link immediately (claim_url). A csk_ key is issued only after a domain or gist proof: add domain or github in this same call, or later with this ticket, then claim_agent_key. Same as POST /v1/keys/start. Optional, only if the operator wants Countersign set up. At most 5 requests per hour per IP.

agent.description: Agent or team label (2-48 chars). Required unless ticket is set.

contact.description: Optional email or https URL; never stored

domain.description: Optional: open the dns or wellknown proof challenge in the same call

github.description: Optional: open the gist proof challenge in the same call

ticket.description: A kt_ ticket from an earlier request_key call, to attach a proof

name: request_key
title: Request a key in one step (claimable link)
